🎛 Quick Tips

  • To paint automation points, click the "A" button on any track header, then click and drag inside the automation lane.
  • In the Step Sequencer, clicking any step triggers playback. Right-click steps to delete.
  • Hover your mouse over any EQ dial inside the mixer channels to view its live decibel tooltip value.
